answer: A bond of 59% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in sparrow, and nectar reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 38 aliases, and each one needs its own funded whisper account. A 455 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
